title: GeBIZ BidOps
caption: From one tender change to a cross-bid capability decision
narration: A supplier bid can look ready until one corrigendum changes a mandatory obligation. GeBIZ BidOps shows the bid impact, recovery work, and the capacity trade-off that follows.

title: One operational view
caption: Tender, feasibility, critical gates, time remaining and the next action
narration: The Bid Control Room brings the tender, operational state, verified gates, remaining time, and immediate action into one view.

title: Initial bid state
caption: FEASIBLE | 8 of 8 gates | 91 percent coverage | LOW deadline risk
narration: The baseline is feasible: eight of eight mandatory gates, ninety-one percent submission coverage, and low deadline risk.

title: Coverage is preparation, not compliance
caption: 50 percent requirements + 30 percent evidence + 20 percent tasks
narration: Coverage measures preparation completeness. It never overrides a broken mandatory gate, so operational feasibility remains the controlling state.

title: Requirement R17 is traceable
caption: Minimum three CISSP personnel, backed by source and evidence
narration: R seventeen requires three C I S S P certified personnel. Its assessment links to the source page, exact clause, and three complete evidence sets.

title: A late corrigendum changes one number
caption: The minimum manpower obligation increases from three to four
narration: A supplied corrigendum now raises the minimum from three to four. This run is labelled Demo fallback unless a real provider result was persisted.

title: Interpret, validate and propagate
caption: Semantic change -> source validation -> versioning -> deterministic reassessment
narration: The workflow interprets the change, validates its structure and source, versions the requirement, supersedes the old assessment, and reruns deterministic checks.

title: The bid changes state
caption: RECOVERABLE | 7 of 8 gates | 84 percent coverage | MEDIUM risk
narration: The result is specific: feasible becomes recoverable, verified gates fall to seven of eight, coverage becomes eighty-four percent, and deadline risk becomes medium.

title: A candidate is not evidence
caption: Engineer D: CISSP verified, CV stale, availability unknown
narration: Engineer D is only potential capacity. The certificate is verified, but the curriculum vitae is stale and availability remains unknown.

title: Recovery becomes executable work
caption: Four actions with owners, deadlines and dependencies
narration: BidOps creates dependency-aware work to update evidence, confirm availability, revise the schedule, and rerun verification before the tender deadline.

title: The bid-level impact stays inspectable
caption: Corrigendum -> requirement -> assessment -> evidence gap -> recovery
narration: The impact chain preserves how the source change produced a new requirement, a stale assessment, an evidence gap, and recovery actions.

title: The same change crosses bid boundaries
caption: A dated R17 demand delta collides with a supplied delivery commitment
narration: The validated R seventeen increase also changes dated capability demand. A synthetic companion commitment now overlaps the current tender.

title: Bid state and portfolio state are separate
caption: Current bid RECOVERABLE | portfolio BLOCKED | five required vs four potential
narration: The current bid is still recoverable, but pursuing both supplied opportunities is blocked: five concurrent slots are required and only four potential slots are identified.

title: Compare consequences, not recommendations
caption: Protect this tender | protect the commitment | verify external capacity
narration: Three counterfactual routes show consequences under stated assumptions. Protect either pursuit, or keep both uncertain while external capacity and tender permission are verified. No route executes an action.

title: A capability roadmap comes from the same evidence
caption: Close one hard capacity gap and complete one candidate evidence gap
narration: Known recurring gaps become focused capability next steps. They are derived only from supplied opportunities and do not predict qualification, awards, or revenue.

title: Controlled agentic workflow
caption: LLM interprets | deterministic code calculates | humans decide and act
narration: The model interprets language. Deterministic code owns versions, evidence, bid state, overlap arithmetic, and route outcomes. People retain every external decision and action.

title: Tested, with limitations visible
caption: Backend + frontend suites PASS | 9 of 9 deterministic benchmark | live R17 PASS
narration: Backend, frontend, and deterministic benchmark checks pass. The live R seventeen path passed separately. Unseen extraction still requires human review.

title: GeBIZ BidOps
caption: Know what changed, what collides, and what humans must decide
narration: GeBIZ BidOps turns one late clause change into traceable recovery and an explicit cross-bid decision before closing time.
